name: Bitter-ash
desc: Bitter-ash (Euonymus atropurpureus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Euonymus atropurpureus is a species of shrub in the genus Euonymus and the larger bittersweet family. It has the common names American wahoo, eastern wahoo, burningbush and hearts bursting with love.
